== Summary ==
Unscaled source-pixel crops from [[:File:V7-L-yoda-2018-07-08.gif]] and [[:File:V7-L-yoda.gif]], showing the earlier printed “just-drawn” and later “just drawn”. Only the comparison canvas and labels are new; card pixels were not repainted. Lucasfilm Ltd.; original full faces published by the Players Committee.
